base_member_text: [L1-L6602] (MED/kind-portability) The declaration uses the nonstandard REAL*8 form while every constructor literal lacks an explicit double-precision kind, so the constructor is formed from default-real constants before conversion to the declared element kind.
audit_member_text: [L1] (LOW/nonportable type declaration) The lookup table is declared with the nonstandard `real*8` form rather than an explicit project or `iso_fortran_env` kind, making its precision compiler-dependent.

adversarial.rationale: The LOW portability concern is limited to compilers or strict language modes that reject the REAL*8 extension; this declaration specifies eight-byte storage on the supported GNU/Intel implementations, rather than leaving the element kind at default real. The independently real precision issue in other_wording is the unkinded constructor literals, which round at default-real precision before widening when default real is narrower than eight bytes; scripts/generate.py:239-251 preserves those literals and morphevolution.F90:3055-3169 uses the table without restoring that precision.
